svg.title: V-17. Start-up and engagement sequence (SysML v2 view startupSequence)
svg.desc: Sequence view generated from the SysML v2 model for WP-S-03 §4.1 (Figure 4-1). Lifelines from the driver and the vehicle through the relay and the safety MCU to the host processes pandad, card, controlsd and selfdrived. One row per step ST-01 to ST-21 in four phases: the message or action, its condition in brackets, the safety MCU or selfdrived state after it, its status (as inherited, required in the reference build, required and not yet implemented), the record transitions it stands for and its code reference.
svg.text: WP-S-03 §4.1 Table 4-1 from ignition on to engaged actuation; each lifeline is an element of the model, each step names the record transitions it stands for
